cases.prompt: A fictional integrated dossier calls converged flowsheets validated, averages away missing seals and inspection coverage, counts repeated instrument readings as independent runs, assigns SIL from LOPA arithmetic and marks G7 complete with unnamed reviewers. Write an integrative review using both public CSVs that restores every evidence and arithmetic boundary.

rubric.criterion: Recomputes integration, economic, dynamic, scale and residual relationships without operational or rating claims
Audits every wetted component, traveler/joint, inspection/NDE, nonconformance and MOC record with HOLD for gaps
Separates control/alarm/interlock claims, correlation, PAT and deviation/OOS/OOT/CAPA evidence
Rejects SIL, tolerable-risk and IPL approval from arithmetic and tests barrier independence
Evaluates G0–G7 and ends only in bounded synthetic review states with named real reviewer requirements

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic fictional evidence; it is not a grade, qualified engineering/safety/inspection/statistical/regulatory review, achieved readiness, process validation or commercial release.
